description:
Spotify to Teams Status Sync

Automatically syncs your currently playing Spotify track to your Microsoft Teams status message. Set a custom status message using placeholders like {artist}, {track}, {album}, and {emoji}.
What's Changed

- fix: Spotify client timeout+UA and redirect_uri allowlist by @Carme99 in #502

- fix: surface keychain secret conflict to the user by @Carme99 in #505
- feat: device-code expiry countdown with one-click fresh code by @Carme99 in #506
- feat: quit-time deferred-update confirmation with version check by @Carme99 in #507
